mechanics.claim: Wither interrupts the target's attack windup when first applied.
mechanics.quote: ''Wither'' interrupts the target's {{tip|attack windup}} when it is first applied.

mechanics.claim: The slow and cripple both increase every second over the duration, reaching their maximum at the end.
mechanics.quote: both increasing every second over the duration

mechanics.claim: The cripple reduces the target's attack speed, calculated from the slow's base values rather than being affected by slow resist indirectly.
mechanics.quote: ''Wither's'' cripple effectiveness calculates from its slow's base values, thus {{tip|slow resist}} will not interact with the attack speed modifier indirectly.

mechanics.claim: The slow and cripple from Wither are treated as a single debuff, so slow immunity blocks both.
mechanics.quote: Both {{tip|slow}} and {{tip|cripple}} from ''Wither'' are considered to be a single {{tip|debuff}}.
